lead.headline: Bulls Beat the Delay, the Injuries and the Wolves
lead.subhead: Grounded flights got Chicago to Minneapolis only on game day, three rotation players sat out, and the Bulls still won 117-106 for a second win in two nights. Norman Powell scored 23, Matas Buzelis added 18 and nine rebounds, and Minnesota's five-game streak ended. A short-handed team on no sleep still won. No excuses.

articles.hed: Gane Holds the Belt After an All-Time Brawl
articles.body: Josh Hokit came out at a pace that looked impossible to survive for three rounds. Ciryl Gane survived it, then won the last two rounds and kept his heavyweight title 48-47 on all three cards at UFC 334. Champions find another gear when the other guy is out of gas.

Amanda Nunes took the early rounds, but Kayla Harrison kept working her judo throws and locked in a rear-naked choke in the fourth to keep her bantamweight title. Absorb the surge, stay on your game plan, and close.

mindset.body: The Bulls' flight got grounded. They landed on game day, missing three players, and still beat a team on a five-game heater. Conditions are never perfect: the pipeline is thin, the week is long, the market is noisy. Winners play anyway and play harder. Plan the week today like you're already ahead of it. Competitive. Unbeatable. Always rising. fall down 7 stand up 8.

bodyOpener.title: 3-Minute Opener
bodyOpener.note: Sunday, the day of the Sun: run this right after Morning Charge. It's about 29° and clear outside, so keep the RipStick finisher indoors. Start the week's body work before the week starts.

moves.name: Push-ups
moves.body: Crisp reps, chest to floor. If you hit 30 early, hold high plank until the minute mark.

moves.name: Plank
moves.body: Elbows or hands. Ribs down, glutes on. Breathe slow.

moves.name: RipStick finisher
moves.body: Dom's RipStick (RipRight): hold sticks at chest → inhale and pull apart as wide as possible → with bands open, exhale and push arms straight out while keeping them apart (dynamic isometrics / Push-Pulls). Smooth continuous reps for the remaining time.

items.body: Kayla Harrison kept the bantamweight belt with a rear-naked choke at 1:29 of the fourth.
Stephen Thompson stopped Charles Radtke on the prelims, and Caio Borralho swept Yousri Belgaroui 30-27 on the main card.
Late Romans honored Sol Invictus, the sun that sinks every night and is never defeated. Every dawn proves it. The mystics read that as a picture of the soul: it can go down, and it rises anyway.

'That which is below is like that which is above.' The Emerald Tablet, attributed to Hermes Trismegistus, became the motto of alchemy. Practical read: your small daily actions mirror the big life you're building. Fix the small and the large follows.

The 14th-century Dominican mystic taught that there is a still ground in every person that nothing outside can touch. He also preached that the active life done well beats ecstatic visions. Find the stillness, then go work.

grimoire.title: Grimoire
grimoire.source: From the wisdom attributed to Solomon
grimoire.hed: Commit the work, and the plans hold
grimoire.body: Solomon wrote: 'Commit thy works unto the LORD, and thy thoughts shall be established' (Proverbs 16:3). Hand over the outcome, keep the effort. A plan you're committed to stops wobbling every time the week pushes on it. Sunday is the day to set the week's plans down firmly.

techDemo.title: Tech Demo
techDemo.kicker: Fast learn · from your X bookmarks
techDemo.pick: Is your RAM running at the speed you paid for? Open Task Manager, go to Performance and then Memory, and check 'Speed' at the bottom. If it's below your kit's rated speed, XMP/EXPO is probably off in the BIOS.
techDemo.author: @hypertune_
techDemo.note: No new bookmarks since Nov 11, so this is a rotated one from Oct 26. It's a two-minute check that can mean free FPS.
techDemo.skipped: Skipped: promo, gaming-combo and one-liner posts.

lesson.oneLiner: RAM ships at a safe default speed; its rated speed needs a BIOS profile.
beats: Compare it to the rating on the stick or box (e.g., 6000 MT/s).
If it's lower, enable XMP (Intel) or EXPO (AMD) in BIOS and save.
lesson.takeaway: One toggle can recover the performance you already paid for.
